From Lyallpur to Faisalabad – a journey through history, Partition memories, and one of Pakistan's most fascinating cities.
In this vlog, we explore Faisalabad, Pakistan's third-largest city, formerly known as Lyallpur.
From the iconic Clock Tower (Ghanta Ghar) and the historic Eight Bazaars to the 1921 Central Cooperative Bank building, this city still carries traces of its pre-Partition past.
